_meta.description: Partnership ceremony data and post-partnership content for all 6 romance candidates.

ceremony_dialogue.officiant_opening: Friends of Coppervale! We gather today to witness a partnership — a promise made not just between two people, but to this community we've built together.
ceremony_dialogue.officiant_vows: Do you, Jack, promise to stand with [PARTNER_NAME] through every season, every raid, every quiet evening and every storm?
ceremony_dialogue.officiant_declaration: Then by the authority vested in me by this town and its people — I declare you partners. May your workshop always hum and your hearth always burn warm.

crowd_reactions.npc_spark: WOOOO! YEAH! This is the BEST DAY!
crowd_reactions.npc_pip: They're MARRIED! Wait, are they married? Is this married?!
crowd_reactions.npc_maren: Oh, my dears. My heart is so full. Oren would have loved this.
crowd_reactions.npc_kaydee: Drinks are on the house tonight! ...Don't get used to it.

morning_dialogue_pool: Morning! I already scouted the perimeter. Habit. Coffee?
I mapped three new routes in my head while you were sleeping. Is that weird?
Hey. Still here. Still choosing this. Every morning.
evening_dialogue_pool: Tell me about your day. Every gear and bolt.
I found something on my run today. Closing my eyes. Hold out your hand.
The stars are good tonight. Come look. Bring a blanket.

partner_activity.name: Joint Expedition
partner_activity.description: Explore together — Leera scouts while Jack salvages. Double discovery chance.

npc_leera.anniversary_line: One year. You know what? I'd race you to The Hollow and back right now. For old times' sake.

morning_dialogue_pool: G-good morning. I made tea. The chamomile kind you like.
I checked your hands while you slept. No new calluses. Good.
The greenhouse is blooming. I named the biggest flower after you. Don't tell anyone.
evening_dialogue_pool: How are you? Really. Not the engineer answer. The real one.
I saved you some of the herbal blend I made today. It's calming.
Can we just sit? Quietly? I like quiet with you.

partner_activity.name: Herb Garden
partner_activity.description: Tend the greenhouse together — Michelle grows, Jack builds trellises. Rare herb yield bonus.

npc_michelle.anniversary_line: One year. I still can't believe you built me a greenhouse. I still can't believe you chose me.

morning_dialogue_pool: Coffee. Don't talk to me until I've had coffee. ...Good morning.
I dreamed about inventory management. This is YOUR fault.
You're still here. Good. I mean — obviously you're still here. Whatever.
evening_dialogue_pool: Long night at the Gear. Come sit with me. Don't talk. Just sit.
I saved you the good stuff. Top shelf. Don't tell the customers.
You know what nobody tells you about love? It's exhausting. In the best way.

partner_activity.name: Tavern Improvements
partner_activity.description: Build upgrades for The Rusty Gear — Jack engineers, Kaydee designs. Community morale bonus.

npc_kaydee.anniversary_line: One year. I still don't have a witty comeback for how you make me feel. I've stopped trying.

morning_dialogue_pool: Good morning. I've already drafted a schedule for today. Yours is on the table.
The sunrise was 7% more vivid than yesterday. I'm tracking it. For... personal reasons.
I wrote my mother again. This time I didn't apologize for staying.
evening_dialogue_pool: Tell me about the machines. I find your explanations... soothing.
I reorganized the bookshelf. By subject, then author, then publication date. You're welcome.
Jack. Thank you for letting me be imperfect in front of you.

partner_activity.name: Administrative Optimization
partner_activity.description: Janis coordinates town logistics while Jack engineers solutions. Resource efficiency bonus.

npc_janis.anniversary_line: One year. I had a speech prepared. But you taught me that sometimes the best words are the simplest. I love you.

morning_dialogue_pool: Good morning. I've been sewing since dawn. I made you a pocket square. It's nothing.
The morning light is perfect for dyeing. Want to help? I'll teach you.
I chose this. Every morning I wake up and I choose this. I want you to know that.
evening_dialogue_pool: I finished a new tapestry today. It has our workshop in it. And two figures. Guess who.
Can I mend that shirt? It has a tear on the shoulder. I noticed three days ago.
Tell me about your day. All of it. Even the boring parts. Especially the boring parts.

partner_activity.name: Textile Engineering
partner_activity.description: Combine Kiery's weaving with Jack's engineering — create reinforced fabrics. Armor quality bonus.

npc_kiery.anniversary_line: One year. I made you something. It took a month. Every stitch is a day I chose you.

morning_dialogue_pool: Good morning. I've bookmarked three passages I think you'd appreciate.
Coffee is on the counter. I measured the grounds precisely. You'll notice the difference.
Wren's memorial day was yesterday. I went. I told him about us. He'd approve.
evening_dialogue_pool: I catalogued twelve new documents today. A productive day by any measure.
Read to me? Anything. I just want to hear your voice while I organize these notes.
The Archive closes at dusk. But home opens at dusk. I like that symmetry.

partner_activity.name: Research Partnership
partner_activity.description: Paige researches while Jack engineers prototypes. Blueprint research speed bonus.

npc_paige.anniversary_line: One year. I started a new section in the Archive. 'Personal History.' It begins with you.
